import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_91/training_0.csv"
    ]

    # Target schema columns and types
    target_columns = [
        'Name', 'Position', 'Age', 'Team_from', 'League_from',
        'Team_to', 'League_to', 'Season', 'Market_value', 'Transfer_fee'
    ]

    # Read all source tables (only one source in this case)
    dfs = []
    for file in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
        dfs.append(df)

    # Since source schema matches target schema exactly, we can union (concat) all source tables
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Enforce target schema and types explicitly
    # Convert columns to target types:
    # Name, Position, Team_from, League_from, Team_to, League_to, Season -> string
    str_cols = ['Name', 'Position', 'Team_from', 'League_from', 'Team_to', 'League_to', 'Season']
    for col in str_cols:
        combined_df[col] = combined_df[col].astype(str)

    # Age -> integer
    # Some Age values might be float or missing, convert carefully
    combined_df['Age'] = pd.to_numeric(combined_df['Age'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

    # Market_value -> float (some NaNs allowed)
    combined_df['Market_value'] = pd.to_numeric(combined_df['Market_value'], errors='coerce')

    # Transfer_fee -> integer (some missing values possible, fill with 0)
    combined_df['Transfer_fee'] = pd.to_numeric(combined_df['Transfer_fee'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

    # Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
    combined_df = combined_df[target_columns]

    # Write the combined dataframe to the target path
    combined_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_91/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
